title: Make a starter template
touches: A small game made in Aven
summary: Templates are the little games people start from in the New Game screen. Make one that shows off an idea: a racing game, a puzzle, a maze...
why: A good template is how many beginners take their first steps.
learn: Making a game easy to change

steps.text: Make a small, fun game. Cooking a recipe (Create > Game from a Recipe) and changing it is a great start.
Keep it tidy: clear object names, a few comments in scripts, and settings people can change in the Inspector.
Optional: write a Learn tutorial for it (see the 'Write a Learn tutorial' quest).
Press 'Package as a template' at the bottom of this quest. It copies your game into templates/ with a picture.
Restart Aven: your template appears in New Game. Try making a game from it.
Send it as a pull request.

submit: Open a pull request adding your templates/<name> folder. Put 'Quest: make-a-template' in the description.
